quote.text: To suffer change can be no hurt; as no benefit it is, by change to attain to being. The age and time of the world is as it were a flood and swift current, consisting of the things that are brought to pass in the world. For as soon as anything hath appeared, and is passed away, another succeeds, and that also will presently out of sight.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Embrace every phase of your child's growth as a natural, inevitable change, much like the ever-flowing current of life. Accepting that moments are fleeting helps in cherishing the present without undue anxiety over what comes next.
    • Recognize that children, like the transient events of the world, evolve through stages. This perspective encourages you to nurture their unique development and be patient during transitions.
  • Leadership
    • Understand that change is the norm in any organizational journey. As a leader, cultivate an attitude of resilience, accepting that both successes and setbacks are part of a continuous evolution.
    • Just as the swift current carries all that appears and fades, effective leadership involves guiding your team through inevitable changes, adapting strategies with flexibility and calm determination.
  • Product Management
    • In the realm of product management, the rapid pace of innovation mirrors the transient nature of existence. Embrace change as an opportunity to refine, innovate, and stay ahead in the market.
    • Focus on the present moment’s challenges and strengths; every new development is a chance to iterate and improve, much like water constantly reshaping its course without attachment or regret.
